script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Morning, Sarah. September 3rd, 2026.
script.ja: おはようございます、サラさん。2026年9月3日です。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Good morning, Alex. Another damp one, isn't it?
script.ja: おはよう、アレックス。また雨模様だね。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Yeah, and chilly. I mean, 23 degrees is fine, but that drizzle just feels colder. My coffee is extra necessary today.
script.ja: ええ、しかも肌寒い。23度って別に寒くないんですけど、この霧雨が余計に寒く感じさせますね。今日、コーヒーはいつも以上に必須です。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Mine too, but for me, it's tea. High of 23.8, low of 21.7. Seventy-eight percent chance of rain all day.
script.ja: 私もよ、でも私にとっては紅茶ね。最高気温23.8度、最低21.7度。一日中、雨の予報が78パーセントだって。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Cycling in this was… interesting. Water splashing everywhere. My little one actually slept through the whole night last night, so I'm feeling surprisingly okay despite the rain. Usually, I'm pretty sluggish if I don't get sleep.
script.ja: この中を自転車で来たのは…面白かったです。水しぶきがすごくて。うちの子が昨夜は一晩中寝てくれたので、雨なのに意外と元気です。普段、寝不足だとかなりだるいんですよね。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Actually, Sarah, what does 'sluggish' mean? I just used it, but...
script.ja: ところでサラさん、『sluggish』ってどういう意味ですか？今使ったんですけど…

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: It means slow-moving and not very energetic. Like you're dragging yourself.
script.ja: 動きが鈍くて、あまり元気がないことよ。体がだるい、って感じかな。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Ah, that's exactly it. Thanks. Did you see the news headlines?
script.ja: あー、まさにそれです。ありがとうございます。ニュースの見出しは見ました？

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Briefly, yeah.
script.ja: ええ、ざっとね。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: That one about anime high school being different from real high school. It said anime's influence is pretty pervasive sometimes.
script.ja: アニメの高校が現実の高校と違うってやつ。アニメの影響ってかなり『pervasive』なんだなって。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: What does 'pervasive' mean, exactly? I see that word a lot.
script.ja: 『pervasive』って、正確にはどういう意味ですか？よく見るんですけど。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: It means something that spreads widely through an area or group of people. Like, it's everywhere.
script.ja: ある地域や集団に広く行き渡っていることね。どこにでもある、みたいな感じ。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Ah, makes sense. My kid isn't old enough for anime yet, but I can see it happening with my nephews.
script.ja: なるほど。うちの子はまだアニメを見る歳じゃないですけど、甥っ子たちを見てるとそうなりそうです。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: My daughter watches a lot of slice-of-life stuff. Says it's nothing like her actual high school, obviously. Fewer dramatic confessions under cherry blossoms.
script.ja: うちの娘も、日常系のアニメをたくさん見てるわ。もちろん、実際の高校とは全然違うって言ってる。桜の木の下でのドラマチックな告白とか、めったにないものね。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Less dramatic, maybe. But I bet the gossip levels are the same. Or worse.
script.ja: ドラマチックさは少ないかもしれないですけどね。でも、ゴシップのレベルは同じか、もっとひどいんじゃないですか。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Probably. Also, the news about Sendai reusing Fukushima cleanup soil. That's a big step, I guess.
script.ja: そうかもね。あと、仙台が福島除染土を再利用するっていうニュース。大きな一歩だと思うけど。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Yeah, that's… complex. I feel like I read about soil decontamination and reuse every year. I hope they're being super careful.
script.ja: ええ、それは…複雑ですね。土壌除染と再利用の話は、毎年読んでる気がします。すごく慎重にやってほしいです。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: They say it's safe for non-residential areas. Like parks or roads.
script.ja: 居住地域以外なら安全だって言ってるわね。公園とか道路とか。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Oh, I didn't see this one! Japan resumed student exchange trips to Russia after a seven-year hiatus.
script.ja: あ、これは見なかったです！日本がロシアへの学生交流を7年間の『hiatus』を経て再開したと。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: A 'hiatus'? What's that?
script.ja: 『hiatus』って？どういう意味ですか？

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: A hiatus is a pause or a break from something. Like a band going on hiatus.
script.ja: 活動休止とか、一時的な中断のことよ。バンドが活動休止する、みたいな感じ。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Got it. So they just stopped for seven years. I wonder why they're starting again now. Seems like a bit of an odd time.
script.ja: なるほど。7年間止めてたってことか。今になってまた始めるのが不思議ですね。ちょっと変なタイミングに思えますけど。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: The Foreign Ministry said it's for short-term studies.
script.ja: 外務省は短期留学のためだと言ってるわ。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Speaking of things I saw, do you know what tomorrow, September 4th, is in Japan?
script.ja: 私が何か見たといえば、明日、9月4日が日本では何の日か知ってる？

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Tomorrow? Let me guess... some kind of food day? Or maybe a day for socks?
script.ja: 明日ですか？えっと…何か食べ物の日とか？それか靴下の日とか？

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: No, it's くしの日. Kushi no Hi. The day of the comb.
script.ja: 違うわ。くしの日よ。櫛の日。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Comb Day? Seriously?
script.ja: 櫛の日？マジですか？

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Yes. It's a pun. Ku (9) and Shi (4). So, September 4th. Beauticians and others set it up to encourage people to take care of their combs and appreciate beauty.
script.ja: そう。語呂合わせよ。く（9）し（4）。だから9月4日。美容関係者たちが、櫛を大切に扱い、美意識を高めてもらうために制定したそうよ。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Huh. I just use whatever comb is handy. My wife has like five different kinds. I guess I should pay more attention. Maybe it's time to clean mine. Or buy a new one.
script.ja: へえ。僕はいつも手近な櫛を使ってますね。妻は5種類くらい持ってますけど。もっと気を使わないとダメかな。そろそろ自分の櫛も掃除するか、新しいのを買うか…。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Probably a good idea. Mine are all tangled with my daughter's hair anyway.
script.ja: 多分、いい考えよ。私の櫛も、娘の髪の毛でいつも絡まってるもの。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Well, that's something to think about on The Daily Tanu-chan Show. Combs. And my very necessary coffee.
script.ja: ええと、ザ・デイリーたぬちゃんショーで考えるべきことですね。櫛。そして僕にとって必要不可欠なコーヒー。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Indeed. Another busy day ahead.
script.ja: 本当にね。また忙しい一日になりそう。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: You can say that again. My little one's almost walking now, so the chaos is just getting started.
script.ja: まったくだ。うちの子、もうすぐ歩きそうなので、これからが本当の混沌ですよ。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Just wait until they discover anime.
script.ja: アニメを発見するまで待ってなさい。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Oh no. I'm not ready for that.
script.ja: ああ、やめてください。まだ心の準備ができてません。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Have a good one, Alex.
script.ja: 良い一日を、アレックス。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: You too, Sarah.
script.ja: サラさんも。

wikipedia.title: くしの日
wikipedia.description: 1978年（昭和53年）、「く（9）し（4）」の語呂合わせから、美容関係者らが制定。くしを大切に扱い、美容に対する人々の認識を高めてもらうため。
